'''Commerce''' was a series of groups that were part of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]]. In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of its existence, COMPNOR's Commerce agencies worked with the commercial houses within their jurisdiction to design and promote economic programs to improve [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] economies in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Amongst the successes credited to Commerce was the [[Corporate Sector System Development Programs]], known as "D-Progs", which rendered aid to frontier worlds that suffered during the fall of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to make them self-sufficient. Other programs, such as the [[Native Management and Industrialization Service]] on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], were less successful.<ref name="ISB" /> One of their major successes was the establishment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on [[Sevarcos II]] using prison labor.<ref name="FTS">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Commerce was used to conduct industrial espionage against the large commercial houses and targeting those companies that were suspected of sympathizing with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Commerce was also used as a conduit to pass on breakthroughs discovered by [[Science/Legends|Science]] to companies loyal to the Empire.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Commerce requisitioned some [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] resources in order to shut down Rebel supplies and technological equipment.<ref name="SW:EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
